implement.summary: Defect on BASE_SHA (INFERRED from code, VERIFIED by the 8 BASE failures in artifacts/w09-04-r3/regress-base.log): apps/mobile/src/flow/CeremonyHost.tsx presented any queued ceremony via FullWindowOverlay with no knowledge of other surfaces — BrandNoticeHost (src/design/BrandNotice.tsx) rendered its error notice overlay independently, PaywallScreen (src/screens/PaywallScreen.tsx) and the notification permission request (src/notifications/notificationStore.ts requestPermission) did nothing to hold a ceremony, so a rank-up/streak/walkthrough could stack under/over a notice, the paywall or the system permission sheet. Nothing recorded which control opened a ceremony, so VoiceOver focus was never returned (SettingsScreen replay row → walkthrough). RankUpCelebration.tsx, StreakCelebration.tsx and FirstRunWalkthrough.tsx each called AccessibilityInfo.announceForAccessibility from render-time effects that re-fired on re-measure/rerender, so the same message could be announced more than once per presentation. Fix (write paths): src/flow/ceremonyRequest.ts gains a small surface arbiter — claimSurface(kind) with kinds notice|ceremony (slots, priority notice>ceremony, one presented at a time) and permission|paywall (blockers: permission withdraws notice+ceremony, paywall withdraws ceremony only so the paywall's own Terms/Privacy failure notice still shows over it), useSurfaceSlot() hook, openCeremonyFrom(trigger, open) trigger capture, and restoreFocusToTrigger() which wraps findNodeHandle in try/catch so an unmounted trigger returns false instead of throwing into RootErrorBoundary. CeremonyHost.tsx claims the 'ceremony' slot, captures the trigger per request, restores focus when presentation returns to null, and exposes announce() through PresentationContext with per-(presentation id, message) dedupe via useCeremonyAnnouncement; a ceremony withdrawn by paywall and re-presented is a new presentation and announces again. Wiring (listed in out_of_scope_files): BrandNoticeHost claims 'notice'; PaywallScreen claims 'paywall' for its mount; requestPermission wraps the native sheet in claimSurface('permission'); SettingsScreen wraps replay() in openCeremonyFrom(row); the three celebration components route announcements through useCeremonyAnnouncement. Regression suite __tests__/w09OverlayArbiter.test.tsx (13 tests): 8 fail on BASE_SHA and all pass on HEAD; AC1 40/40, AC2 tsc exit 0, AC3 eslint+prettier exit 0, root pnpm format:check exit 0, git diff --check exit 0, full mobile jest 6077 passed / 1 documented skip. Pushed devin/pp/w09-04/impl-r3 at 1216c58884b64ad90ab80f18e41ed12400b34dce (5 commits over BASE, no PR, no force-push). UNKNOWN: real VoiceOver focus/announcement behaviour on device — Linux Jest cannot prove native accessibility; the Mac runner was not used per instructions.
